notes:
Summary: Tallpine is an enterprise search vendor for legal and compliance teams. Heavy emphasis on RAG workflows — open to Redwood as inference + routing layer but vector DB integration is the gating factor. They currently run Pinecone for vectors and an in-house cross-encoder reranker. Goals: reduce p95 query latency to <120ms for top-5 rerank, cost per query target <$0.01, ability to index 50M+ docs with metadata filters (jurisdiction, client, doc_type).

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (Alyssa) — product fit, high-level infra needs.
- 2026-02-05: Demo of Redwood hosted API (showed streaming + function-calling).
- 2026-02-20: Tech deep-dive (Rohit + infra) — discussed batching, KV cache, hybrid search. FF transcript: ff_20260220_call_0321.
- 2026-03-03: Security questionnaire submitted; follow-up on SSO/KMS (ff_20260303_tech-deep-dive).
- 2026-03-08: POC scope agreed — index 10M docs, compare Pinecone vs pgvector ingestion speed, run reranker as separate step and as integrated Redwood model endpoint.

Technical notes / requirements (shorthand):
- Index scale: target 50M docs (avg 1.2k tokens), ingestion velocity ~200k docs/day during initial migration. Need bulk ingest + resumable upserts.
- Vector stores in scope: Pinecone (current), pgvector (Postgres in prod), Elastic vector extension for hybrid keyword+vector. Need connector adapters for all three.
- Connector requirements: incremental upserts, metadata tagging, namespace/tenant isolation, list of supported distance metrics, batched writes with backpressure, consistent idempotency, checksum/validation, ability to do hybrid queries (SQL + vector filter) and return top-K with vector scores. Prefer connectors that can run inside customer VPC for Private deployment.
- Reranking: currently external cross-encoder calling service adds 120-300ms after retrieval. Want option to run condensed reranker in Redwood pipeline (single call or chained streaming) to avoid additional network hops. Need control over candidate K, re-rank batch size, token budget accounting for cost.
- Latency SLOs: P95 end-to-end <150ms for search+rerank (goal <120ms on Dedicated), throughput target ~200 qps for peak.
- Cost targets: all-in cost per query <$0.01 — includes embedding retrieval, model rerank compute, and vector DB ops. Looking for Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching, quantization, routing to smaller re-ranker model for most queries).
- Security/compliance: strict residency for EU clients, SOC2 required, SSO via SAML, KMS for key management. Audit logs retention configurable to 1y+.

POC details:
- Phase 1 (03/15-03/31): ingest 10M doc subset to Dedicated sandbox. Test connector for Pinecone and pgvector. Measure index time, write QPS, storage footprint.
- Phase 2 (04/01-04/15): run 100k query replay, measure recall@10 and rerank latency/quality delta (A/B: in-house reranker vs Redwood model pipeline).
- Evaluation criteria: p95 latency, recall lift from reranker, cost per 10k queries, operational burden (ops tickets/time to ingest), security sign-off.

Quotes & paraphrases: "We like Pinecone for operational simplicity but pgvector gives us cost control — need both in the mix." — Head of Search.

Stubs / links: pricing deck: drive:Tallpine - Redwood pricing & architecture v2. Jira RWD-1742 created for connector feature request (pgvector upsert idempotency). Gmail threads referenced for security questionnaire.

Next meeting: 2026-03-18 (POC kickoff) — Rohit to run ingestion checklist and send connector runbook.

Sales notes (AE): focus on Dedicated for latency guarantee + Private for EU residency. Emphasize Optimize recommendations (batch sizes, quant profiles) to meet cost goals. Address blocker: get SE sign-off on pgvector connector and provide architecture diagram for in-VPC connector deployment.
short_summary: Evaluation for RAG + reranking. Large-scale indexing target (50M docs). Need vector DB connectors (Pinecone/pgvector/Elastic) with upsert, metadata filters, hybrid search. POC to ingest 10M docs; goal p95 <120-150ms and cost per query < $0.01.
deal_notes: Recommend Dedicated + Optimize. Build connector spec PR (RWD-1742). Prioritize pgvector upsert idempotency and in-VPC connector docs.
